dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Low visual prominence with soft boundary sharpness of pale gray fringes against the darker folded primary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: An irregular rectangular patch of high-contrast white pixels on the black posterior neck region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, linear boundary separating the black cephalic region from the uniform grayish-blue mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinctive circular rufous patch on the lower right flank and prominent white spotting on the black lateral wing plumage.
